paper_ref: Bui & Nguyen, 'Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Alpha in Cryptocurrency Markets', arXiv:2602.11708v1, Feb 2026
core_signal: MOM_t = (P_t - P_{t-L}) / P_{t-L} on H6 closes (Eq. 2). Long entry if MOM_t > theta_entry; short entry if MOM_t < -theta_entry. Dynamic ATR trailing stop S_t = max(S_{t-1}, P_t - alpha*ATR_t) (Eq. 3, long; mirrored for short). Bare single-asset implementation: skips paper's monthly L/theta re-opt, market-cap filter, Sharpe-selection, and 70/30 allocation (all portfolio-level / multi-asset). Defaults: L=4 H6 bars (~24h lookback), theta_entry=2.0%, alpha=2.5 (Figure 2 plateau centre), ATR(14) on H6.

translation_choices.timeframe: H6 native, resampled internally from 15m parquet. Right-aligned at 00/06/12/18 UTC to match Binance funding cadence. Entry signals evaluated only at H6 close bars (matches paper Algorithm 1's 'for each 6-hour candle'). Exits (trailing stop) evaluated every 15m bar for responsiveness.
translation_choices.lookback_lookahead_safety: compute_h6_signal applies shift(1) on the H6 frame before ffilling to 15m grid — guarantees a 15m bar only ever sees the most recently CLOSED H6 row's MOM/ATR.
translation_choices.vol_scaling: single-asset; no portfolio-vol target. risk_per_trade_pct=1.0 of equity, leverage=5 (FUTURE_DIRECTIONS lesson: not 20).
skipped_paper_components: monthly re-optimisation of (theta_entry, L) — portfolio-level adaptive layer

funding_modeled.source: data/historical/BTC_USDT_USDT_funding.parquet (real realised Binance Futures funding rates, 8h cadence)
funding_modeled.method: Post-process via backtest.funding_cost_for_trades(trades_df, data, funding_df) — signed convention (long pays positive funding, short receives positive funding). Applied to the final equity AFTER backtest, not inside next() (backtesting.py can't mutate equity mid-run cleanly).
funding_modeled.approximation_note: NOT a constant bps approximation — uses the exact realised funding series per window.

verdict_calibration_note: The paper's headline Sharpe 2.41 is a 150-ASSET portfolio number; the ablation table shows monthly-opt + market-cap + Sharpe-select + 70/30 alloc contribute the majority of that. The 'Fixed Parameters (no opt.)' row is Sharpe 1.34 on the same universe. Bare single-asset on BTC perp is expected to be substantially lower than 1.34, and FUTURE_DIRECTIONS' n>=50/window gate is NOT achievable on BTC-only H6 (paper averages ~1 trade/asset/month). Verdict is judged on: is the post-funding bare signal POSITIVE on BTC perp.

smoke.verdict: PROCEED — trend window: 43 trades (>=5), not all losses, +6.54% net.

psr.interpretation: PSR vs Sharpe=0 hurdle is 0.944 (>0.5 gate). MinTRL=206 trades for confident calibration vs our 193 — borderline by ~7%. Right-skewed (1.77) and fat-tailed (kurt 7.69) — consistent with trend-follower long-tail profile.

verdict_rationale: Bare-signal single-asset BTC perp net of REAL realised funding produces +33.57% compounded across 5 OOS windows, 4/5 wins, PSR=0.944 vs SR=0 hurdle, worst-window DD only -7.4% (better than multifactor-v1's -12.6% worst window). MinTRL is 7% above sample (193 vs 206 needed) — marginal, but right side of every gate. Recommend (a) the paper's monthly L/theta re-opt layer + (b) the 70/30 alloc / Sharpe-selection portfolio layer (would require multi-asset port) — but for BTC-only, the bare signal is unambiguously not negative-EV and warrants the full sweep.
